plain.li: [eat,hungry] Good, {PET_nameDef} has found {PET_objective}self a meal.
[eat,hungry] {PET_nameDef} was hungry enough to go and catch {THING}.
[eat,hungry] Somebody should have fed {PET_nameDef}, but {THING} will do.
[eat,hungry] Look at {PET_nameDef} wolfing down {THING}, poor thing was starving.
[eat,sport,small] {PET_nameDef} caught {THING}, that's one less in the fields.
[eat,sport,small] There goes {THING}, {PET_nameDef} never misses.
[eat,sport,small] {PET_nameDef} doesn't even need it, {PET_pronoun} just likes the chase.
[eat,sport] {PET_nameDef} brought down {THING} all on {PET_possessive} own.
[eat,big] {PET_nameDef} took down {THING}, and it was no small thing.
[eat,pack] The two of them ran {THING} down together, like a proper pack.
[eat,pack] They hunted it as one, I didn't know they could do that.
[eat,body:bird] {PET_nameDef} dropped on {THING} out of nowhere.
[eat,pokemon] {PET_nameDef} caught {THING}, a Pokémon has to eat too.
[carry] {PET_nameDef} has caught {THING} and is carrying it off somewhere.
[carry] Where are you taking that, {PET_nameDef}?
[carry] {PET_nameDef} won't eat it, {PET_pronoun}'s taking it to someone.
[carry,small] {PET_nameDef} is trotting off with {THING} in {PET_possessive} jaws.
[carry,body:bird] {PET_nameDef} has {THING} in {PET_possessive} talons and is off with it.

warm.li: [eat,hungry] Eat up, {PET_nameDef}, you earned that one.
[carry] Somebody is about to get a present from {PET_nameDef}.

plain.li: [small] For me, {PET_nameDef}, you shouldn't have.
[small] Thank you, {PET_nameDef}, I'll put it in the pot.
[small] Is that {THING}, {PET_nameDef}, all for me?
[small] Good {PET_nameDef}, what a fine present.
[small] I'll take it to the kitchen, {PET_nameDef}, thank you.
[small] You caught it and you brought it home, clever {PET_nameDef}.
[big] You dragged {THING} all the way here, {PET_nameDef}?
[big] That's supper for half the colony, {PET_nameDef}.
[body:bird] You dropped {THING} right at my feet, {PET_nameDef}.
[pokemon] A present from my partner, thank you, {PET_nameDef}.

warm.li: [small] You thought of me, {PET_nameDef}, didn't you.
[small] Come here, {PET_nameDef}, you're the best hunter we have.

plain.li: [area] {PET_nameDef} is hungry, and the food is all where {PET_pronoun} isn't allowed.
[area] Who shut {PET_nameDef} out of the stores, {PET_pronoun} hasn't eaten all day.
[area] {PET_nameDef} can't get at the food from where we keep {PET_objective}.
[area] We need to let {PET_nameDef} out to the food, {PET_pronoun}'s going hungry.
[forbidden] All the food {PET_nameDef} could eat is forbidden, somebody fix that.
[forbidden] {PET_nameDef} is starving next to food nobody will let {PET_objective} touch.
[none] There's nothing here {PET_nameDef} can eat, and {PET_pronoun} is getting thin.
[none] We have nothing fit for {PET_nameDef} to eat, we need to lay something in.
[none] {PET_nameDef} keeps looking at me, and I have nothing to give {PET_objective}.
[none,pokemon] My partner is hungry and we have nothing {PET_nameDef} can eat.

warm.li: [area|forbidden|none] Poor {PET_nameDef}, nobody has fed you today, have they.
